rapport_notes: Remarkable sustained patience through many repetitive billing questions from a detail-obsessed price-shopper, ending in an explicit compliment from the customer.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiator repeats found; note the rep leaned on schedule-scarcity language ("can't guarantee... fills up fast") right after the customer hesitated on booking, which is a borderline pressure move worth watching rather than a scored violation.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No Stage 1 concern was raised requiring digging; the extensive back-and-forth instead happened around billing/curb-dump clarifications in Stage 3.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if it takes two hours, I only pay for the two hours or the minimum, correct -> rep: two and a half hour minimum, if everything only took two and a half hour, you only pay for two and a half

top_strength: Remarkable patience and repeated, clear billing explanations for an unusually detail-oriented, price-shopping customer, ending in a booking and an explicit compliment on how well things were explained.
coaching_note: When the customer said he wanted to think about it before finalizing, the rep leaned on schedule-scarcity ("fills up fast") rather than asking what he was still weighing -- worth watching that this doesn't read as pressure on a more price-sensitive caller.
